title: Re-opening PID controller stability domain in 3D via ruled surface by D-partition
summary: All stabilizing PID controllers form a set in three-dimensional space. A novel viewpoint to its boundary as a ruled surface (or surfaces) being cut with 3D planes is presented. The characterization, being not too new, contributes to an understanding of the stability set as the whole, instead of the classical view as a stack of 2D slices, say, on the P-coefficient. The viewpoint gives clear insight on the structure of the PID stability region, and, in particular, splits its boundary into continuous parts.
